title: Enumeration - licence-board chip graphics (Insurgent's Toolkit License Node Icon values)

container.notes: Enumeration spec: no file layout. The values describe the License Node Icon table that the Toolkit edits live at the pointer [0x02CA9670] (2 groups Available/Obtained x 4 entries; TK L443, L1157). Each entry names a TIM2 icon by texture group / texture section / texture entry plus a CLUT, an animation and an X/Y offset - the same addressing MRP texture entries use (see mrp, tim2). Byte offsets inside an entry are not documented, so no record is given; the enums and presets let an editor fill the fields the Toolkit shows.

LicenseChipEntrySlot.0: Obtained: background chip / Available: shiny background with "get" animation
LicenseChipEntrySlot.1: Obtained: first overlay (level digits, augment or technick icon, gear 20-22 marks) / Available: monochrome icon
LicenseChipEntrySlot.2: Obtained: second overlay (item/HP lore digits) / Available: first overlay (level digits, gear 20-22 marks; 0xFFFF texture link clears it)
LicenseChipEntrySlot.3: not used by any sheet row (the Toolkit table has 4 entries per group)

LicenseChipTextureLink.0: texture group 0, texture section 0 - Obtained backgrounds of weapon licences and Essentials (29 sheet rows)
LicenseChipTextureLink.1: texture group 1, texture section 0 - Obtained backgrounds of magick, armour, accessory, Ribbon and augment licences; Available shiny background of quickenings (13 sheet rows)
LicenseChipTextureLink.2: texture group 2, texture section 0 - Obtained backgrounds of Second Board, Gambits, Technicks; Available shiny backgrounds (gear/magick/augment/gambit, espers); Available monochrome Second Board (18 sheet rows)
LicenseChipTextureLink.256: texture group 0, texture section 1 - Obtained esper backgrounds; Available esper monochrome icons (26 sheet rows)
LicenseChipTextureLink.257: texture group 1, texture section 1 - level-digit overlays: Obtained first overlay (gear/magicks 1-19), Obtained second overlay (item/HP lores), Available first overlay (4 sheet rows)
LicenseChipTextureLink.512: texture group 0, texture section 2 - Obtained shield backgrounds (4 sheet rows)
LicenseChipTextureLink.768: texture group 0, texture section 3 - Obtained quickening background (1 sheet rows)
LicenseChipTextureLink.16384: texture group 0, texture section 64 - Obtained first overlay icons of augment-type licences (Warmage ... HP Lore) (21 sheet rows)
LicenseChipTextureLink.32768: texture group 0, texture section 128 - Obtained technick overlay icons and gear 20-22 marks; Available monochrome icons of non-esper licences; Available gear 20-22 marks (78 sheet rows)
LicenseChipTextureLink.65535: texture group 255, texture section 255 - no texture ("CLEAR IT")

LicenseChipClut.0: palette used by Available First Overlay; Available Shiny Background & Get Animation; Obtained Backgrounds; Obtained First Overlay (e.g. Quickening, Warmage, Martyr, Inquisitor ...; 32 rows)
LicenseChipClut.1: palette used by Available Monochrome Icon; Obtained Backgrounds; Obtained First Overlay (e.g. Swords, Blood Sword, Greatswords, Excalibur ...; 56 rows)
LicenseChipClut.2: palette used by Obtained Backgrounds; Obtained First Overlay (e.g. Heavy Armor, Light Armor, Mystic Armor, Belias ...; 22 rows)
LicenseChipClut.3: palette used by Available Shiny Background & Get Animation (e.g. Gear/Magick/Aug/Gambit, Belias, Mateus, Adrammelech ...; 14 rows)
LicenseChipClut.4: palette used by Available Monochrome Icon; Obtained Backgrounds (e.g. White Magick, Black Magick, Time Magick, Green Magick ...; 53 rows)
LicenseChipClut.5: palette used by Available First Overlay; Obtained Backgrounds (e.g. Gambits, Technicks, Gear 20, Gear 21 ...; 5 rows)
LicenseChipClut.6: palette used by Obtained Backgrounds; Obtained First Overlay (e.g. Essentials, Second Board, Gear 20, Gear 21 ...; 5 rows)
LicenseChipClut.7: palette used by Obtained Backgrounds (e.g. Accessories; 1 rows)
LicenseChipClut.8: palette used by Obtained Backgrounds; Obtained First Overlay; Obtained Second Overlay (e.g. Augments, Gear 1-19, Magicks, Item/HP Lores; 4 rows)
LicenseChipClut.13: palette used by Obtained Backgrounds (e.g. Genji Armor; 1 rows)
LicenseChipClut.14: palette used by Available Monochrome Icon (e.g. Second Board; 1 rows)
LicenseChipClut.15: palette used by Obtained Backgrounds (e.g. Ribbon; 1 rows)

roundTrip: Edits are live memory edits: they only hold while a licence board is on screen and are rebuilt from the game files on any screen change (msg 867); export before leaving the board.

The "1st. Text. Link" value is one u16 = texture group (low byte) + 256 * texture section (high byte) (LC Chip Bin values!E/F formulas =MOD(D,256), =FLOOR(D/256)). Write it as one value or as two bytes, never as two u16.
Texture Entry Link "#" in the sheet means "the node's level - 1" (LC r78, r139, r234); it must be computed per node, not copied.
gaps: Byte layout of a License Node Icon entry (field order and widths) is not in any source; the Toolkit shows the fields by name only.
Which game file the table is built from (and therefore how to make chip changes permanent) is not documented; the Toolkit editor has an Export action (TK L995) but the target file is not named.
Entry slot 3 of each group is not covered by the sheet.
The sheet spells some names oddly (Zoriark = Zodiark, Holology = Horology, Travler = Traveler); labels keep the sheet spelling inside presets.
